authorizationOptions.label: Repositories
authorizationOptions.description: Read and modify public and private repositories.

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.description: GitHub personal access token used with the Authorization Bearer header. Fine-grained tokens are recommended.

auth.label: GitHub App installation
auth.description: Authenticate as a GitHub App installed on an account. The runtime signs a JWT with the App's private key and mints one-hour installation access tokens on demand, so no token is pasted or stored. The token can read the repositories the installation selected plus the content of any public repository; user-only actions such as get_current_user are not supported.

fields.label: App ID
fields.description: The numeric App ID shown on the GitHub App's settings page under About.

fields.label: Installation ID
fields.description: The numeric id of the installation to act as, from the installation's settings URL (…/settings/installations/<id>) or the installation_id query parameter of the post-install redirect.

fields.label: Private key (.pem)
fields.description: The full contents of the private key file generated on the GitHub App's settings page, an RSA key in PEM format. Escaped \n line breaks are accepted.
